kaf-hachayyim/1:_: (1) [Seif 1] In the diaspora where they observe two days of Yom Tov etc. — and even though now we are expert in the fixing of the month, nevertheless Chazal instituted to observe in the diaspora two days of Yom Tov, because Chazal were concerned lest the kingdom decree not to engage in Torah and the secret of intercalation would be forgotten and they would make a deficient month full and a full month deficient and they would eat chametz on Pesach — Beitza daf 4b and Rashi there; and see below note 10.
kaf-hachayyim/2:_: b) And the sons of Ai in siman 19 observe Sunday as a custom that they never did two days.
kaf-hachayyim/3:_: c) The gist of this is found on this road: every place that is between Jerusalem and Jerusalem is more than ten full days' journey, we do 2 days to the world per the previous custom, and no emissaries every Tishrei and Teshrei arrive except to a place between it and Jerusalem a journey of 10 days or less, and approximately 100 days between it and Jerusalem, a journey of 10 days or less. And Nub and Tiberias and the like in them they observe the first day only, and if the same place is from Syria such as Tire and Damascus and Ashkelon and the like or from abroad such as Egypt and Ammon and Moab and the like in them they do per the custom of their ancestors in their hands if the first day is the first day and if the second day is the second day the Rambam Shem Din 11.
